clue.text: This should cause sparks to fly!

definitions.text: This should cause sparks to fly!

parts.words: This should cause sparks to fly!
parts.note: a cryptic description of the difference in outlook between parents and children that sets off heated rows

explanation.definitionFit: The difference in attitudes between young and old people is a classic source of family friction and argument.

clue.text: Indian provincial governor gets the green light!

parts.note: Goa is a state (formerly a province) of India
a head is the person in charge, a governor

explanation.surface: An Indian regional ruler receives official approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' is a link word; the definition is a noun phrase, permission to proceed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean official permission to start, a signal to proceed.

clue.text: The boy's up on time! Right, one student can have a breather

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: the boy is a son
I is the Roman numeral one
L is a learner driver's plate letter, a student

explanation.surface: A lad is out of bed on time, and a student may take a short rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns SON into NOS; 'breather' looks like a rest but means something you breathe through.
explanation.definitionFit: Each opening of the nose is an organ through which air is drawn in, hence something that breathes.

clue.text: Recorded primate trapped in the outskirts of Telford

indicators.note: trapped in says one piece is held inside another piece
the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters only

parts.note: an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A monkey caught on the edge of a Shropshire town is filmed.
explanation.walkthrough: Telford is a town in Shropshire, England; its first and last letters T and D hold APE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something taped has been captured on tape, i.e. recorded.

clue.text: Simple single flock of sheep

parts.note: single means one
a fold is a pen for sheep, and by extension the flock in it

explanation.surface: A lone sheep is described as plain and simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Onefold is an old word for single-natured, undivided, hence plain or uncomplicated.

clue.text: Good computer memory on London police loop

parts.note: ROM is read-only memory in a computer
the Met is the Metropolitan Police of London

explanation.surface: Fine computing hardware is placed on the London police force's network.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word: in a down clue the pieces simply stack in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A grommet is a ring or eyelet, a small reinforcing loop for a hole.

clue.text: Put a coat on an exotic dancer? This would take it off!

parts.note: to paint is to put a coat on a surface
a stripper is an exotic dancer

explanation.surface: Dress up a striptease artist, and this product will undress it again.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on the dancer taking clothes off; the definition is the solvent that removes a coat of paint.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical solvent used to remove old coats from woodwork and walls.

clue.text: Blundering idiot on credit!

indicators.note: in an across clue, X on Y means X is placed after Y

parts.note: an ass is an idiot

explanation.surface: A fool who blunders while buying on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: Crass means grossly stupid or insensitive, as in a clumsy, blundering mistake.

clue.text: The directors support cutting kitchen equipment

indicators.note: in a down clue, support means one piece is placed under the other

parts.note: chopping means cutting
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Company bosses back spending cuts on kitchen fittings.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'support' means sitting underneath; 'cutting' looks like spending cuts but is simply the act of slicing.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden or plastic slab on which food is sliced is a basic kitchen utensil.

clue.text: Sprinkle on one sort of sausage

parts.note: to pepper is to sprinkle or scatter
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Instructions to season a single type of sausage.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy Italian-style salami used on pizzas, a kind of sausage.

clue.text: A canapé could be the ultimate solution

indicators.note: could be says the letters may be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A party nibble might be the answer to everything.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure-all remedy, the one fix for every problem.

clue.text: Managed to follow maiden, but went too far

parts.note: a maiden is a cricket over in which no runs are scored
ran means managed, as in ran a business

explanation.surface: Someone ran things after a girl, but overstepped the mark.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a maiden is a set of six balls from which no runs are scored; 'to follow' fixes the order of the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To overrun is to exceed a limit, going beyond the intended point or time.

clue.text: Mad to change, accepting alternative when one's on the threshold!

indicators.note: accepting says one piece takes the other inside it
change says the letters are to be rearranged

parts.note: or introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: Being crazy enough to swap options while standing at a door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' rearranges the two words 'Mad to' into DOMAT, which 'accepting' then opens to take the alternative word inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A mat placed at an entrance for wiping feet lies on the threshold.

clue.text: Reportedly try to sell bicycle?

indicators.note: reportedly says the word is to be heard, not read

parts.note: to peddle is to try to sell goods

explanation.surface: A rumour that someone is trying to sell a bike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bicycle' is the verb here, not the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: To pedal is to ride a bike by pushing its cranks, so the verb means to cycle.

clue.text: Cadet up to change of government by force?

indicators.note: change of says the preceding letters are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A trainee officer is plotting to overthrow the regime.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden seizure of state power, often by the military.

clue.text: Reveal a Parisian, heart-broken

parts.note: une is French for a, as a Parisian would say

indicators.note: broken says the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A heartbroken Frenchwoman shows her feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth is to dig up or bring to light, i.e. to disclose.

clue.text: Toe-eating treat!

annotationWithheld.why: Toe-eating treat! (9): the anagram of TOE-EATING gives the answer, but 'treat' must be both the definition and the anagram indicator, one word doing two jobs

clue.text: What's left on the plate set girl off!

indicators.note: off says the letters are to be rearranged, as in gone off

explanation.surface: Leftover food on a plate puts a girl off her dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Tough cartilage in meat is typically left uneaten on the plate.

clue.text: Crying out for a weapon — but what!

definitions.text: Crying out for a weapon — but what!

parts.words: Crying out for a weapon — but what!
parts.note: a playful description of a riot-control weapon whose effect is to make people weep

explanation.definitionFit: A chemical agent dispersed against crowds that makes the eyes stream.

clue.text: Moslem star back home?

parts.note: the sun is a star

indicators.note: back says the word just before it is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A celebrity Muslim returns home.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of the larger branch of Islam is a Muslim.

clue.text: The French are in because it's quiet!

indicators.note: in says the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: since means because
le is French for the

explanation.surface: The French have arrived, so all is calm.
explanation.definitionFit: Silence is an absence of sound, stillness or quiet.

clue.text: Warnings of theatrical reviews

explanation.surface: Critics' write-ups as cautionary words.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal advance warnings, and critics' printed write-ups of a play.

clue.text: Group protecting equipment from thief

indicators.note: protecting says one piece surrounds and shields another

parts.note: a band is a group
a rig is a set of equipment

explanation.surface: A gang guarding its kit from a robber.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigand is a bandit, a robber of travellers.

clue.text: Excitement about whisky with a chaser?

parts.note: a dram is a small measure of whisky

explanation.surface: A thrilling tale about a shot of whisky followed by a chaser.
explanation.definitionFit: Drama can mean exciting or emotional events, a commotion.

clue.text: The sort of desk that might turn better

parts.note: to roll is to turn over
to top is to better or surpass

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture that could revolve to improve.
explanation.definitionFit: A desk with a flexible slatted cover that slides up into the frame.

clue.text: A tough par to play, then sign

indicators.note: to play suggests the letters are moved about

explanation.surface: A golfer faces a hard par, then signs the card.
explanation.definitionFit: A celebrity's handwritten signature, as given to fans.

clue.text: During the Hellenic era it was more pleasant

indicators.note: during says the answer sits within the following words

explanation.surface: Life was better in ancient Greek times.
explanation.definitionFit: Nicer is the comparative of nice, meaning more agreeable.

clue.text: Frogmen are mainly different!

parts.note: the main is poetic for the open sea, so mainly is read as of the deep sea
divers is an old word meaning various or different

explanation.surface: Frogmen are, for the most part, unusual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mainly' looks like 'mostly' but is read as 'of the main', the deep sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Underwater swimmers in diving gear are known as frogmen.
